mapper.sql: select lead_id, display_name, phone, phone_hash, unionid, app_user_id, visitor_id, minor, stage, grade, score, owner_user_id, first_source, first_channel, first_content, first_touch_time, last_source, last_channel, last_touch_time, touch_count, merged_into, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from abr_lead
mapper.insert: insert into abr_lead (display_name, phone, phone_hash, unionid, app_user_id, visitor_id, minor, stage, first_source, first_channel, first_content, first_touch_time, last_source, last_channel, last_touch_time, touch_count, create_by, create_time) values (coalesce(#{displayName}, ''), #{phone}, #{phoneHash}, #{unionid}, #{appUserId}, #{visitorId}, coalesce(#{minor}, 'N'), 'new', #{firstSource}, coalesce(#{firstChannel}, ''), coalesce(#{firstContent}, ''), #{firstTouchTime}, #{firstSource}, coalesce(#{firstChannel}, ''), #{firstTouchTime}, 0, #{createBy}, now())
mapper.update: update abr_lead set display_name = case when coalesce(display_name, '') = '' then coalesce(#{displayName}, '') else display_name end, phone = coalesce(phone, #{phone}), phone_hash = coalesce(phone_hash, #{phoneHash}), unionid = coalesce(unionid, #{unionid}), app_user_id = coalesce(app_user_id, #{appUserId}), visitor_id = coalesce(visitor_id, #{visitorId}), minor = case when #{minor} = 'Y' then 'Y' else minor end, update_time = now() where lead_id = #{leadId}

update abr_lead set first_source = case when #{time} < first_touch_time then #{source} else first_source end, first_channel = case when #{time} < first_touch_time then coalesce(#{channel}, '') else first_channel end, first_content = case when #{time} < first_touch_time then coalesce(#{content}, '') else first_content end, first_touch_time = least(first_touch_time, #{time}), last_source = case when #{time} >= last_touch_time then #{source} else last_source end, last_channel = case when #{time} >= last_touch_time and coalesce(#{channel}, '') <> '' then #{channel} else last_channel end, last_touch_time = greatest(last_touch_time, #{time}), touch_count = touch_count + #{count}, update_time = now() where lead_id = #{leadId}
update abr_lead set merged_into = #{intoId}, update_by = 'system', update_time = now() where lead_id = #{leadId} and merged_into is null
mapper.insert: insert into abr_lead_touch (lead_id, source, touch_type, channel_code, content_code, ref_type, ref_id, event_id, summary, occurred_time, create_by, create_time) values (#{leadId}, #{source}, #{touchType}, coalesce(#{channelCode}, ''), coalesce(#{contentCode}, ''), coalesce(#{refType}, ''), #{refId}, #{eventId}, coalesce(#{summary}, ''), #{occurredTime}, coalesce(#{createBy}, ''), now()) on conflict (event_id) where event_id is not null do nothing
mapper.update: update abr_lead_touch set lead_id = #{toId} where lead_id = #{fromId}
mapper.select: select * from ( select occurred_time as "time", 'touch' as "kind", touch_type as "type", source as "source", summary as "summary", channel_code as "channel", content_code as "content", ref_type as "refType", ref_id as "refId" from abr_lead_touch where lead_id = #{leadId} union all select create_time, 'event', event_type, '', '', '', '', coalesce(ref_type, ''), ref_id from abr_event where (visitor_id = #{visitorId} or app_user_id = #{appUserId}) and event_type not in ('app_user_registered', 'app_user_phone_bound', 'plan_moment', 'plan_share_created') union all select create_time, 'tool', tool, '', '', coalesce(channel_code, ''), coalesce(content_code, ''), 'tool_run', tool_run_id from abr_tool_run where visitor_id = #{visitorId} union all select create_time, 'assessment', assessment_status, '', '', coalesce(channel_code, ''), coalesce(content_code, ''), 'assessment', assessment_id from abr_assessment where visitor_id = #{visitorId} ) t order by "time" desc limit #{limit}
select profile ->> 'age_band' from abr_visitor where visitor_id = #{visitorId}
